name: Kamahl, Heart of Krosa — fired, the land has vigilance, indestructible, and haste
notes: Same fault as Sylvan Awakening, on a fired ability with one target: 'target land you control becomes a 1/1 Elemental creature with vigilance, indestructible, and haste' dropped haste. The Mountain is targeted; the Forest is not and stays a plain land.
